correctness.rationale: PASS: Direct differentiation of the given ODE yields (log y)dot=x-1 and Wdot=[log z-2a log y]dot=a(x-1)^2+a-b. Integrating gives exact finite-horizon identities and bounded endpoint terms under eventual positive compactness. If b<a, W grows at least linearly and cannot remain bounded. At b=a, W increases to a finite limit and integral (x-1)^2<infinity; bounded vector field derivatives give uniform continuity, Barbalat x->1 and derivative convergence xdot->0, hence y+az->1+c. Strict decrease of log[(1+c-Y)/a]-2a log Y then selects a unique limit Y,Z>0. Integrating nonnegative Wdot against any compactly supported invariant measure forces x=1 and its invariant support to the equilibrium line; ergodic measures are atoms. For b>a, the limiting moments Ebar(x)=1 and Ebar(x^2)=b/a, along with (M-x)(x-m)>=0, yield (M-1)(1-m)>=b/a-1 and AM-GM the amplitude bound. Independent rational-state substitution at hundreds of tuples confirms only the local algebra; infinite-time conclusions follow from compactness arguments, not trajectories numerics.
